name: @lann/webcrypto-jco
description: Browser-compatible host for lann:webcrypto over the Web Crypto API. No dependencies; map the lann:webcrypto imports to webcrypto.js when transpiling with jco.

scripts.types: node ../../scripts/jco-transpile.mjs types wit --world-name imports --async-mode jspi -o generated --feature chacha20-poly1305 --feature xchacha20-poly1305 --feature sha1-checked --feature rsa-sign
